title: You don't have to write a full-blown sales letter to create a convincing sales page writing sample ☝️ As long as you can show that you write witty, attention-grabbing copy and can lead the readers through the page with a well thought-out structure, you'll be good to go. 👉 Choose a product or service for your sample and study its target audience. Then write a shorter example sales page that includes their pain point and your solution. Present your (or the brand's) credentials to make the sale in the end. #writingsamples #writingportfolio #salespagecopy #salespagetips
